title: Jenkins MCP Config
description: Configuration file for the jenkins-mcp MCP server

url.description: Base URL of your Jenkins instance, e.g. https://jenkins.example.com

username.description: Jenkins username (the login name, used with the API token for HTTP Basic auth)

repoJobMap.description: Optional mapping from git remote URL substring (e.g. host/project/repo or repo slug) to a Jenkins job path. Used to resolve which job(s) to query for the current repository. Values may be a single job path or an array of job paths. Job paths use Jenkins's job-folder syntax, e.g. "folder/sub-folder/job-name" or "my-job".
